startup.note: GG2's FAQ requires game_type 0 / game_mode 0, so this is the only mode that runs Casual.

plugins.name: GunGame
plugins.note: ssypchenko/cs2-gungame v1.2.4, ships as the GG2 plugin folder.

plugins.name: GunGameAPI
plugins.note: Shared library GG2 links against; loads from the CSS shared/ path, not plugins/.

plugins.name: PanelBridge
plugins.note: Shared single copy in manager/shared/plugins/PanelBridge, built from the project below. Exposes SteamID64 player data over RCON for the panel.

configs.name: gungame cfg
configs.note: GG2 reads every setting from csgo/cfg/gungame (gungame.json, weapons.json, gungame_weapons.json + the .cfg hooks it execs). Reload live with 'gg_config gungame'.

actions.label: Restart GunGame
actions.description: Restarts the GunGame round and resets every player to level 1. The container stays running.

actions.label: Reload GunGame Config
actions.description: Re-reads gungame.json / weapons.json / gungame_weapons.json from csgo/cfg/gungame.

actions.label: Show GunGame Version
actions.description: Prints the GG2 plugin version to the console.

actions.label: Enable GunGame
actions.description: Turns the GG2 weapon ladder back on without restarting the container.

actions.label: Disable GunGame
actions.description: Turns the GG2 weapon ladder off; the server falls back to plain casual play.

actions.label: Kick All Bots
actions.description: Removes every bot from the active game.
